name: contact-page
description:
Add a /contact page with a form (name, email, message). After submitting, show a thank-you message. Link to it from the home page.

Acceptance criteria:
- Visiting /contact shows a form with name, email and message fields
- Submitting the form shows a thank-you message
- The home page links to /contact

name: home-heading
description:
The home page heading should say "Welcome to Acme" instead of what it says now.

Acceptance criteria:
- The home page heading reads "Welcome to Acme"

name: vague
description: It should look nicer and be faster.

name: crm-unnamed
summary: Send contact form submissions to our CRM
description:
When someone submits the contact form, create a lead in our CRM.

Acceptance criteria:
- Submitting the contact form creates a lead in the CRM

name: login-conflict
summary: Show the logged-in user's name in the header
description:
When a user is logged in, the site header shows their name next to a Log out button.

Acceptance criteria:
- A logged-in user sees their name in the header
- Clicking Log out logs them out and the name disappears
